question: Are the Chronicle/Sky Farms (USDS → SKY, USDS → SPK and USDS → CLE) eligible for Distribution Rewards?
answer:
Short answer
- The Atlas does not appear to contain a document named “Chronicle/Sky Farms” or an entry for those specific agents/instances, so it does not state directly whether those farms are eligible.  

What the Atlas does say about Distribution Rewards (rules that determine eligibility)
- “The Distribution Reward is paid to Prime Agents that drive adoption of USDS.” [Distribution Rewards](/atlas/2177f303-a0a7-4807-b815-d17aa76a264e)  
- “Net USDS balances held in a DeFi protocol that is receiving an Integration Boost also receive the Distribution Reward.” [Distribution Rewards](/atlas/d71a7b9c-3d0e-4383-9671-098bead326c1)  
- SPK token rewards are explicitly available to USDS users: “SPK token rewards are available to USDS users…” [SPK Token Rewards](/atlas/4f56e3a5-7d4d-4da7-9045-d4d88fabc756)  
- SKY token rewards: “SKY token rewards are not currently available to USDS users.” [SKY Token Rewards](/atlas/caba97e4-4d4d-4aa9-9ed4-f0d1c8b1c552)  
- Regarding Agent-token payouts more generally: “SKY stakers are eligible to receive Agent Token rewards … Agent Tokens are distributed continuously, pro‑rata by staked SKY, among wallets that have opted to receive a specific Agent Token.” [Agent Token Distribution Rewards](/atlas/6aa85298-4f1c-4dc5-a973-99bc1e5293d1) and token-distribution mechanics are described at [Distribution Of Agent Tokens](/atlas/e2f1f01f-3303-41c3-b337-f09eb41ba6be).

What this means for Chronicle / Sky Farms (USDS → SKY, USDS → SPK, USDS → CLE)
- The Atlas provides the rules that determine eligibility (quoted above) but does not identify Chronicle/Sky Farms themselves, so the Atlas cannot on its own confirm their eligibility.  
- If a farm is (a) a Prime Agent that “drives adoption of USDS,” it would fall under the Distribution Reward rule above; and/or (b) a DeFi protocol receiving an Integration Boost and holding net USDS balances, it would also qualify per the Integration‑Boost rule. See the two Distribution Rewards docs cited above for the controlling language.  
- For token-specific behavior: SPK rewards are documented as available to USDS users; SKY rewards are stated as “not currently available to USDS users” in the Atlas. See [SPK Token Rewards](/atlas/4f56e3a5-7d4d-4da7-9045-d4d88fabc756) and [SKY Token Rewards](/atlas/caba97e4-4d4d-4aa9-9ed4-f0d1c8b1c552).

Next step (procedural)
- To resolve eligibility for the named farms you’ll need an Atlas entry or an authoritative facilitator/governance determination that: (i) classifies those farms as Prime Agents or DeFi integrations receiving an Integration Boost, and (ii) specifies which reward token(s) they are configured to receive. The Atlas text cited above is the governing language that such a determination would apply.
